title: Our Approach section
text: — Our Approach We do not simply deliver lessons. We prepare an environment in which a child can teach themselves through dignified inquiry.

title: School description
text: Bringing quality care and experience to learning through authentic Montessori education that nurtures each child's natural curiosity, independence, and love for discovery.

title: Founded in 2016 history
text: Founded in 2016 in Ayeduase, Kumasi, Novastar brings together the Montessori prepared environment with Ghana Education Service standards. Our mixed-age classrooms let a six-year-old read to a three-year-old, and a twelve-year-old model problem-solving for a seven-year-old.

title: Preschool and primary link
text: From Crèche to Junior High, our preschool lays the foundation with uninterrupted work cycles, and our primary school carries that stamina forward into the Great Lessons and BECE preparation.

title: Campus description
text: Our campus is in Ayeduase, Kumasi, on Ayeduase Road near the K-5 Junction traffic light. The low, naturally lit buildings sit on a quiet street, with classrooms that open onto outdoor space for movement and practical work.
